title: Alternative Firing with 43rd Street Studios
source_quote: Sign up here for eight weeks of Alternative Firing starting Monday, January 5th at 6:30 pm! The class continues on Monday nights from January 5th to February 23rd.
evidence_sentence: The Alternative Firing class teaches raku firing, where pieces are removed from the kiln at bright red heat and subjected to post-firing reduction in combustible materials.
evidence_quote: Raku is "a process in which work is removed from the kiln at bright red heat and subjected to post-firing reduction (or smoking) by being placed in containers of combustible materials, which blackens raw clay and causes crazing in the glaze surface."
summary: Eight-week class on raku firing and gas reduction (Cone 10) co-taught by Kourtenay Plummer at Hand / Thrown (weeks 1–6) and 43rd Street Studios (weeks 7–8). Raku is an outdoor barrel kiln process; gas firing offers atmospheric control for reduction effects.
how_to_join: Sign up on Hand / Thrown website
